name: charts
title: Charts
description: Composable responsive Unovis line, area, grouped or stacked bar, donut, and doughnut charts with contrast-safe semantic series, polished interactions, explicit states, and complete semantic table alternatives.

<script setup lang="ts" generic="Datum">
import { VisCrosshair } from "@unovis/vue";
import type { NumericAccessor } from "@unovis/ts";

defineProps<{
  x?: NumericAccessor<Datum>;
  y?: NumericAccessor<Datum> | NumericAccessor<Datum>[];
  yStacked?: NumericAccessor<Datum>[];
  template?: (datum: Datum, x: number | Date, data: Datum[], leftNearestDatumIndex?: number) => string | HTMLElement;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <VisCrosshair v-bind="$props" :circle-radius="5" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { VisTooltip } from "@unovis/vue";
import type { TooltipConfigInterface } from "@unovis/ts";

defineProps<Pick<TooltipConfigInterface, "triggers" | "followCursor" | "allowHover" | "showDelay" | "hideDelay">>();
</script>

<template>
  <VisTooltip v-bind="$props" class-name="balsa-chart-tooltip" />
</template>
